testcase.name: Scenario: Create from a selected template in a collapsed group: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-document-creation-catalog-source/features/application/document-creation/document-creation-catalog-basics.feature:256:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create from a selected template in a collapsed group ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type ✔ And Standard (mm) is selected in the expanded Part group ✔ When the user collapses the Part group ✔ Then its template tiles are hidden ✔ And the details pane still identifies Standard (mm) as a millimeter part template ✔ And Create remains enabled ✔ When the user chooses Create ✔ Then the chooser closes and a new empty part becomes active ✔ And a new document tab is visible alongside the original part ✔ When the user closes the new unedited part ✔ Then the original part becomes active ✔ When the user reopens the template chooser in the same session ✔ Then the Part group remains collapsed ✔ And the details pane identifies Standard (mm) and Create is enabled ✔ When the user expands the Part group ✔ Then Standard (mm) is shown as the selected template ✔ When the user cancels the chooser ✔ Then the original part remains active
